notes.title: Level 3 Update on Demo
notes.content:
Banana Loco Level 3 is Here!

Attention, Banana Hunters! 🍌🚀 The wait is over—Level 3 has arrived in the Demo! Get ready for new challenges, more fun, and exciting surprises!

🔹 What’s new?
✨ Access to Level 3 – Brace yourself for crazier, wilder adventures!
✨ New cards unlocked – Play with the Yellow Map and Green Map cards for fresh strategies!

Are you ready to take Banana Loco to the next level? Update now and start playing!
